posts.title: A FreshRSS extension for BBC News videos
posts.description: BBC News articles scraped into FreshRSS lose their videos to a JavaScript placeholder. I wrote a small extension that swaps it for BBC’s own embeddable player.

posts.title: Tracking Docker Compose updates with Prometheus and Grafana
posts.description: Release feeds and Diun weren't enough to track what needed updating across my hosts, so I built a minimal exporter that turns Compose image drift into Prometheus metrics.

posts.title: Patching PHP Before Remi Does: Rebuilding Remi’s Packages on AlmaLinux
posts.description: Remi’s repo didn’t have today’s PHP security fix, so I rebuilt his PHP 8.5 packages from source on a matching VM and shipped them to prod, with a rollback plan.
